description: The bar chart, titled "How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary Perception," illustrates the performance of three large language models—Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGLM (yellow)—across two knowledge domains: "Songs" and "Basketball." The vertical axis represents the "Ratio (%)," ranging from 60 to 90, indicating the percentage of correct responses or performance. For the "Songs" category, all three models show high performance, with Qwen2 achieving the highest ratio at approximately 94%, followed by Llama3 at about 92%, and ChatGLM at around 77%. In the "Basketball" category, performance is generally lower across all models, with Llama3 scoring approximately 85%, Qwen2 at about 77%, and ChatGLM at around 83%. The chart clearly shows that Qwen2 outperforms the other two models in the "Songs" domain, while Llama3 performs best in "Basketball," suggesting a difference in model strengths across knowledge domains.
